description: The same check in the proposed x402 Trust Check shape (docs: keptvow.com): before paying, give the payment's network, payTo, asset and amount (atomic units) and get verdict ok, careful or stop, a reason, an evidence link and a signed attestation. Free, no key.

amount.description: Optional: the amount in the asset's atomic units.

asset.description: Optional: the asset, as in the payment requirements.

network.description: Optional: the CAIP-2 network, e.g. eip155:8453.

payTo.description: The address the payment would go to.

name: payment_trust_check
title: Payment trust check
